msg: Host path /var/run/docker.sock only exists while Docker Desktop (or dockerd) runs. Rootless Podman serves $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/podman/podman.sock after `systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket`; mount that path instead.
gateway.docker.internal and kubernetes.docker.internal are DNS names injected by Docker Desktop. Podman has no such names; point at host.containers.internal or at your own cluster's API address.
host.docker.internal is Docker Desktop's name for the host. Podman's own name is host.containers.internal; older Podman releases do not add the Docker alias, so use the Podman name.

credsStore "desktop" calls docker-credential-desktop, which ships with Docker Desktop and disappears when it is uninstalled. Podman reads ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/containers/auth.json; run `podman login` or set credsStore to pass/secretservice.

The desktop-linux Docker context and the docker-desktop Kubernetes context exist only inside Docker Desktop. Use a Podman machine connection (`podman system connection`) and a kind or minikube cluster context.
Host port below 1024. Rootless Podman cannot bind it unless net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start is lowered on the host (or the Podman machine); map to 8080/8443 instead.
Unqualified image name. Podman resolves short names through registries.conf (short-name-mode enforcing) and can prompt or fail in CI; write the full name, e.g. docker.io/library/nginx:1.27.

docker scout, docker extension and docker desktop are CLI plugins bundled with Docker Desktop; podman has no such subcommand. Replace scout with a standalone scanner (e.g. trivy or grype) before uninstalling.
podman buildx is only an alias for podman build; buildx bake, create and use have no Podman equivalent. Replace bake files with one `podman build --platform` (plus `podman manifest`) per target.

The docker-in-docker dev container feature starts a privileged nested dockerd. Under rootless Podman switch to docker-outside-of-docker pointed at the Podman socket and set dev.containers.dockerPath to podman.
